evidence.title: GitHub - OmerMakesStuff/downshift-shadcn-combobox: Combobox/autocomplete component built with shadcn/ui and Downshift. · GitHub

name: Shadcn/ui + Downshift Combobox
summary: Combobox/autocomplete and command-palette input for React, built with shadcn/ui and Downshift's useCombobox hook.
description: An autocomplete input and command palette with a list of suggestions, assembled from shadcn/ui components and Downshift's useCombobox hook. Installs into an app with the shadcn CLI as a single registry item, and the repo includes a demo app with a more advanced example.
contains: autocomplete input and command palette with a list of suggestions
single shadcn registry item, installed with the shadcn CLI
demo app with a more advanced usage example
